data.cultural_impact: The name Amrish holds cultural significance as it is associated with the God Amrish, who represents prosperity, happiness, and good fortune in Hindu mythology. This name is reminiscent of the magical power of life, hope, and perseverance.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Amrish lies in its root word, Amrta, which symbolizes immortality, eternal happiness, and the divine nectar of life. It is a reminder of the eternal nature of life and spirituality and the longing for ultimate liberation from the cycle of birth and death.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
